-- ref ItemRef.lua SetItemRef (l.2-63): the chat-link click router. `link` is the payload -- inside |H...|h ("item:2947:0:0:0" / "player:Name"), `text` the full escaped link, -- `button` the mouse button. function SetItemRef(link, text, button) if strsub(link, 1, 6) == "player" then local name = strsub(link, 8) if name and strlen(name) > 0 then -- ref l.6-7: collapse a space-separated name to its last token (a no-op for -- the single-token names 1.12 uses). name = gsub(name, "([^%s]*)%s+([^%s]*)%s+([^%s]*)", "%3") name = gsub(name, "([^%s]*)%s+([^%s]*)", "%2") if IsShiftKeyDown() then -- ref fills a visible ADD_IGNORE/ADD_FRIEND/… popup editbox first (those -- dialogs are the friends/ignore arc, deferred), else the chat editbox, -- else SendWho (the /who arc, deferred) — we take the ref's editbox tail, -- both branches guarded. if ChatFrameEditBox and ChatFrameEditBox:IsVisible() then ChatFrameEditBox:Insert(name) elseif SendWho then SendWho("n-"..name) end elseif button == "RightButton" then FriendsFrame_ShowDropdown(name, 1) else ChatFrame_SendTell(name) end end return end if IsControlKeyDown() then -- ref l.50: ctrl-clicking an item link in chat previews it on your own character -- (decision 1060). `text` is the FULL escaped link, not the bare payload — -- DressUpItemLink pulls the id out of it itself. DressUpItemLink(text) return end if IsShiftKeyDown() then if ChatFrameEditBox and ChatFrameEditBox:IsVisible() then ChatFrameEditBox:Insert(text) end return end ShowUIPanel(ItemRefTooltip) if not ItemRefTooltip:IsVisible() then ItemRefTooltip:SetOwner(UIParent, "ANCHOR_PRESERVE") end ItemRefTooltip:SetHyperlink(link) end
-- Minimal FriendsFrame stand-in for the chat-name right-click menu (ref FriendsFrame.lua -- l.35-47). The full social window (friends/ignore/who tabs) is a later arc; this hosts -- only the name-only FRIEND dropdown the chat links share with the unit popups. function FriendsFrame_ShowDropdown(name, connected) HideDropDownMenu(1) if connected then FriendsDropDown.initialize = FriendsFrameDropDown_Initialize FriendsDropDown.displayMode = "MENU" FriendsDropDown.name = name ToggleDropDownMenu(1, nil, FriendsDropDown, "cursor") end end
function FriendsFrameDropDown_Initialize() UnitPopup_ShowMenu(getglobal(UIDROPDOWNMENU_OPEN_MENU), "FRIEND", nil, FriendsDropDown.name) end
